reported.quote: For the quarter ended 31st December 2025, we are pleased to report that our Company delivered 46% YoY growth in consolidated revenues
EBITDA for the quarter grew by 34% YoY with EBITDA margins at 12.7%.
At the PAT level, the Company delivered its highest ever Q3 PAT at ₹ 6.3 billion, reflecting 36% YoY growth.
Capital expenditure for the quarter was ₹ 3.4 billion, taking the 9M FY26 total to ₹ 10.9 billion
Revenues grew 30% YoY, crossing ₹200 billion milestone.
The W&C business delivered very strong performance, recording 53% YoY revenue growth during the quarter.
This growth was led by domestic W&C business, which posted an exceptional 59% YoY growth
In volume, the domestic W&C business recorded nearly 40% growth, reflecting healthy underlying demand.
Our international business maintained its steady momentum, recording a 5% YoY growth during the quarter
The FMEG segment sustained its impressive growth momentum, delivering a 17% YoY increase in Q3 FY26
During Q3 FY26, EPC revenues grew by 4% YoY, reaching ₹ 4,069 million.
Segment profitability stood at ₹ 272 million, translating to a margin of 6.7%.
